access_limits: Direct eLife article HTML returned a client challenge; no bypass attempted. PMC full text and publisher CDN PDF/supplements were accessible.
Web screenshot responses did not expose images to this runtime; local Poppler rendering and image inspection verified report p2, overview p1 and paper p3.
conclusion: Freeze a conservative assertion graph in raw source time coordinates. Study-level hours and biological-sheet labels are supported; exact timing, observation support and source inclusion remain unresolved. No prospective-population or dose-specific outcome inference is authorized by this evidence alone.
